title: Nox-OS provisioning file (nox-provision.json)
description: Written to the boot partition of a freshly flashed Nox-OS card (by the PC dashboard's 'Raspberry Pi einrichten' assistant, or by hand). Read once at the next boot, imported, then overwritten and deleted. Checked by os/pi-gen/stage-nox/04-firstboot/files/nox_setup.py (validate), which refuses anything this schema does not allow. See os/README.md, 'The provisioning file'. At most 16 KiB, UTF-8.

hostname.description: The device's name in the home network (RFC 1123 label, lower case, not only digits).

timezone.description: An IANA time zone name the image has under /usr/share/zoneinfo.

locale.description: The system language (the locales the image has generated).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 Wi-Fi regulatory country; required with wifi.

wifi.description: The home Wi-Fi, or null for none (Ethernet).

ssid.description: 1 to 32 bytes in UTF-8, no control characters.

psk.description: WPA2/WPA3-transition passphrase (8-63 printable ASCII characters) or a 64-digit hex key; null for an open network.

claim_hash.description: sha256 of 'nox-claim-v1:' + the claim code printed on the setup card (upper case, without spaces or dashes; Crockford base32, 8-32 characters). Without it the device makes a claim code at every boot.

hotspot_psk.description: The setup hotspot's WPA2 password, printed on the setup card: 16 to 63 printable ASCII characters without spaces (a random one: about 80 bits or more). Without it the device makes 16 random characters (80 bits) at every boot.

reclaim.description: Forget the owner at this boot (physical access is full access): every paired device, node and token is revoked, the security PIN cleared, the next claim sets a fresh maintenance passphrase; Nox's other data stays. The same as a file named nox-reclaim on the boot partition.
